units.title: mit2_086f14_assignment_1
examples: area of a surface of revolution from radius data
build a row array of the first N terms

index of the interval holding a point
loop until a Fibonacci term passes a limit

examples: fraction of springs within a stiffness band by sampling
function returning a Monte Carlo area and its confidence interval
sequence of array operations on a 20 × 40 matrix

falling ball with drag by an ODE solver
pass a function handle to another function

units.title: mit2_086f14_assignment_5
examples: equilibrium of three masses on springs as Au = f
function that finds a root for a parameter

units.title: mit2_086f14_assignment_3
examples: acceleration of a ball from noisy heights by a quadratic fit
calibrate an IR distance sensor by least squares
